title: ISO 513 workpiece material groups, and how a material named in Specify is placed in one

source.agreement: both give the six groups and what each holds (read 2026-11-07)

groups.P: steel and cast steel, other than austenitic stainless steel
groups.N: non-ferrous metals, such as aluminium and copper alloys, and non-metallic materials
groups.H: hardened steel and chilled cast iron

placing._comment: A stand-in: specify-core's answer is the material's name (part.material), not its family, so the name is matched against these words, first match wins, ignoring case. Tool steel is placed in P as supplied (annealed); hardened it is H, which a name does not say. A printed or unnamed material has no group.
